h: Peller and Carter Efe nominated for Best International Streamer
p: The two Nigerian streamers are up against Ashswag, Young Multi and Staryuuki at the 2026 Streamer Awards in Los Angeles on 12 November. Voting closes 31 October, and the public vote counts for 70% of the result.
